<script>
function rectsOverlap(a, b, pad = 8) {
  return !(
    a.right < b.left + pad ||
    a.left > b.right - pad ||
    a.bottom < b.top + pad ||
    a.top > b.bottom - pad
  );
}

function updateMpcbcLogoText() {
  const logo = document.querySelector(".mpcbc-container");
  const intro = document.querySelector("#intro_start");

  if (!logo || !intro) return;

  const logoText = logo.querySelector(".navbar-title");
  if (!logoText) return;

  const overlaps = rectsOverlap(
    logoText.getBoundingClientRect(),
    intro.getBoundingClientRect(),
    12
  );

  logo.classList.toggle("logo-text-hidden", overlaps);
}

window.addEventListener("resize", updateMpcbcLogoText);
window.addEventListener("scroll", updateMpcbcLogoText);
window.addEventListener("load", updateMpcbcLogoText);

new ResizeObserver(updateMpcbcLogoText).observe(document.body);

const intro = document.querySelector("#intro_start");
if (intro) {
  new MutationObserver(updateMpcbcLogoText).observe(intro, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true,
    characterData: true
  });
}
</script>

<!-- before body ends-->
```{=HTML} 


<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  $('#dude').tooltip({
    html: true,
    placement: 'top',
    trigger: 'hover focus',
    container: 'body',
    template: `
      <div class="tooltip dude-tooltip" role="tooltip">
        <div class="arrow"></div>
        <div class="tooltip-inner"></div>
      </div>
    `
  });
});
</script>

<script>

$.get('/CONTENT/main/intro_start.md', function(txt) {
    const htmlContent = marked.parse(txt);
    $('#intro_start').html(htmlContent);
    updateMpcbcLogoText();
});

</script>

<script>
// intro text as modal
$(document).on('click', '.show-read-more', function(e) {

  $.get("/CONTENT/main/intro.md", function (intro_text) {

    bootbox.alert({
      animate       : false,
      scrollable    : true,
      size          : "xl",
      centerVertical: true,
      message       : marked.parse(intro_text),
      backdrop      : true,
      closeButton   : true, 
      
      onShow : function(e) {
        $('#dude').tooltip('hide');
        $(this).find('.modal-footer').remove();
        $('#intro_start').hide();
        $('#dude').css('opacity', '0.05');
        $('#Earth').css('opacity', '0.05');
      }, 

      onHide : function(e) {
        $('#intro_start').show();
        $('#dude').css('opacity', '1');
        $('#Earth').css('opacity', '1');
      }, 




    });
  });
})

</script>





```
